From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to open IC4 Inference Engineer req — interview slate & scheduling

Team —

We need authorization to open an IC4 "Backend Inference Engineer" requisition and begin scheduling interviews. The role is to support an upcoming customer pilot (Canopy Tech) and we have one strong referral (Alex Johnson) ready to move through interviews this week.

Quick summary:
- Role: Backend Inference Engineer (IC4) — focus on KV-cache, batching, and runtime reliability
- Candidate: Alex Johnson (referral) — resume attached (AJ_Resume_SrBackend.pdf)
- Business reason: pilot kickoff in Q3 — require 2 senior IC hires to meet throughput SLA
- Budget: ~$210k midpoint; need confirmation of level and compensation band

Asks:
1) Approve opening req in Greenhouse (REQ-4582) so TA can send calendar invites.
2) Confirm hiring manager interview panel (I propose Marcus as hiring manager, Marissa for system design, and Tessa for culture/operational fit).
3) Approve interview slate (attached: interview-slate-IC4.pdf) and candidate travel policy exception if we need onsite slot.

Attachments: JD-Inference-IC4.pdf, AJ_Resume_SrBackend.pdf

If you approve, I will create the req (link below), kick off scheduling, and ask TA to run the take-home exercise only if panel agrees.

Greenhouse draft: https://greenhouse.redwood.example/reqs/REQ-4582

Thanks,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

---

Kim —

Thanks for the heads-up. I support opening the req and interviewing Alex this week. A few quick notes: 
- Confirming I will own hiring manager interview.
- For system design, please include one question focused on KV-cache eviction/latency trade-offs; Marissa — can you own that?
- Compensation band: IC4 midpoint $210k (as listed) is fine, but I want flexibility up to $230k for exceptional candidates. Please confirm total comp range (base + eq).
- Scheduling: mornings this week are best (Tue–Thu 9–12 PT).

If TA creates calendar invites and includes a 30m screen + 60m system-design, Ill be available for the 60m.

Marcus
